paragraphs.text: Codex-style change review for DeepSeek Harness: hover pill above the composer plus a syntax-highligh
ted right-sidebar diff page with revert.
# dsh-diff-review
Codex-style change review for DeepSeek Harness. Whenever the agent edits files, a pill above the com
poser reports **N files changed +M −K** for that turn; hovering it floats the file list up, and the
right sidebar shows each file's syntax-highlighted diff with a one-click revert.
English | 中文
- **A pill above the composer**: centered over the input box (not in a sidebar), counting only the f

iles **the current turn** touched and resetting at each new turn.
- **One pill, nothing else**: `N f
iles changed +M −K` — no separate "Review" or "Refresh" buttons. Hover opens the list, a file row op

ens the review page, and polling refreshes every 2 seconds.
- **Hover only**: moving into the dock f
loats the list up from above it and turns the caret up (`▴`); moving away fades it out. Clicking the
pill itself changes nothing. The list is absolutely positioned, so it never pushes the composer dow

n; in a short window its max height shrinks to the space above and the rest scrolls.
- **Per-turn co
unts**: edits to the same file within one turn are measured against that turn's starting content, fo

r both the counters and the diff — not just the last edit.
- **Counters bump**: a small springy lift

when a number changes (`prefers-reduced-motion` disables it).
- **The list hugs its content**: as w
ide as the longest file name, never a stretched empty right side; only a genuinely long path clamps

at the composer width with an ellipsis.
- **Names left, counts right**: names start at one left edge

; the two counter columns are right-aligned columns.
- **Above the native docks**: the pill sits abo

ve the native todo and queue docks, which keep their own appearance untouched.
- **Right-sidebar rev
iew page**: a tab strip along the top (browser-like tabs, scrollable sideways) and the whole area be

low is the selected file's diff — no side-by-side panes.
- **Syntax highlighting**: the language com
es from the file extension (`dart`, `cpp`, `py`, `js`, `mjs`, …) and colors come from the client's o
wn shiki highlighter and theme tokens; a not-yet-loaded grammar renders plain until it loads, then r

epaints.
- **Scroll performance**: diff rows are grouped 60 at a time into `content-visibility: auto
` boxes, so off-screen groups skip layout and paint; highlighting and element construction are memoi
zed per payload. A 2000-row diff scrolls at p50 16.7 ms / p95 17.7 ms per frame (containing every ro

w individually instead degrades to p50 20.6 ms).
- **Conservative revert**: writes back only while t

he file still matches what was recorded, and reports a conflict instead of overwriting blindly.
- **
Only the agent's own writes**: recorded from `edit` / `write` tool results (recognized by result sha
pe, so Code-Mode sub-dispatches count too); `>` redirection or `sed -i` inside bash is not tracked.
The list that floats up on hover:
The review page: tabs on top, the whole diff below, colored by Dart grammar.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the app afterwards (the plugin list is read at startup). In the desktop app, use your own pr
ofile name instead of `web`.
## Use
Just let the agent edit files. Once the pill appears during a turn:
- hover it to float the file list up, move away to dismiss (hover only; clicking the pill does nothi
ith the tabs at the top, and use "Revert all" to put this turn's changes back.
To remove it again, delete `dsh-diff-review` from the `dsh.profile.bundles` list in your profile's `
package.json` and restart.
## API
All three routes are behind the browser session (the page calls them same-origin, so the cookie ride
routes are behind the browser session (the page calls them same-origin, so the cookie rides along):
| Method | Path | Purpose |

| GET | `/api/diff-review.changes?sessionId=` | this turn's changed files + summed line counts |
| G
ET | `/api/diff-review.diff?sessionId=&path=` | one file's diff rows + both full sides (for whole-fi

le highlighting) |
| POST | `/api/diff-review.revert` | `{ sessionId, paths? }`; omit `paths` for th

g) |
| POST | `/api/diff-review.revert` | `{ sessionId, paths? }`; omit `paths` for the whole turn |
## How it works
- `index.js` (Host): records `before`/`after` from a `tools/post-execute` listener, groups changes b
y turn from `session/event` `turn/start`, and serves the three routes above. The diff is computed in

-house with an LCS walk, so it needs no `git` and works outside repositories.
- `client.js` (browser
): the `conversation.input.dock` pill plus the `sidebar.right.pane.tab` review page, with a zh/en di

ctionary.
- `test/host.test.mjs`: Host-side unit tests — `node --test test/host.test.mjs`.
- UI regr

essions (each needs `BASE=… TOKEN=…` pointing at an instance with the plugin loaded):
- `test/review

.mjs`: review-page layout + syntax colors (stubbed data);
- `test/popover.mjs`: hover open, upward p

lacement, fade in/out, caret direction, click does nothing, composer stays put;
- `test/order.mjs`:

the pill sits above the native todo dock;
- `test/shot.mjs`: dock screenshots and the name→counter g

ap;
- `test/width.mjs`: the list hugs its content (`ONE=1` single row, `LONG=1` long path, `WIN=760,

800` narrow window);
- `test/counter.mjs`: counter right-alignment + the bump animation (`getAnimati

ons()` proves it runs);
- `test/multi-edit.mjs`: three edits to one file in one turn — asserts cumul

ative counts and the full diff;
- `test/perf.mjs`: scroll frame times over a 2000-row diff (and the

single-pill shape);
- `test/dart.mjs` / `test/e2e.mjs`: end-to-end runs with a real turn.
## Known limits
- Records live in process memory: after a restart, older chats have no history diff until they run a

new turn.
- Each session keeps the most recent 12 turns.
- Diffs are truncated past 4000 lines per

side.
- Deleted files do not go through `edit`/`write`, so they are not shown as changes.
- Client-s
ide `dsh.client` changes (new slots, bundle shape) **need an app restart**; editing `client.js` cont
ent does not hot-reload an already-open page (client-hmr only covers runtime-rebuilt bundles; instal
led plugins need a restart).
